name: kernel-path
description: Kernel Path: an open learning platform for Linux and automation. Engine, compiler and content.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kernel-path/engine && kernel build content --out dist/content && node scripts/publish-lab.mjs dist && node scripts/publish-schemas.mjs dist && node scripts/inject-meta.mjs dist && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist
scripts.validate:content: node packages/schema/scripts/build-validators.mjs --check && kernel validate content && node scripts/validate-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-widget-content.mjs && node scripts/generate-report-schema.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-authoring-support.mjs --check
scripts.test:browser: npm run validate:content && python3 tests/browser_checks.py && python3 tests/mobile_checks.py
